newsitem.title: UK: Britain advises citizens in Cambodia to stay home.
newsitem.headline: Britain advises citizens in Cambodia to stay home.

text.p: The British embassy in Cambodia has advised Britons living in the country to stay at home after the eruption of fighting in Pnomh Penh between rival government troops, a Foreign Office spokesman said on Sunday.
He said Britain was also advising travellers to steer clear of the country for the time being.

There are some 4-500 people in Cambodia for whom Britain has consular responsibility. The spokesman said these people were being advised to listen to the World Service of the BBC for updates on the situation.
